title: Profile surface renders form with WCAG 1.3.5 autocomplete tokens on every identifier
iWant: name, email, birthday and country inputs whose autocomplete tokens follow WCAG 1.3.5 exactly, and save success and failure announcements that keyboard-only and screen-reader users can rely on
soThat: my browser autofill fires correctly and my success and failure feedback is announced

acceptanceCriteria.description:
GET /account/profile renders a
with inputs carrying autocomplete tokens "name" on the full-name field, "email" on the email field, "bday" on the birthday field and "country" on the country field; save-success renders
Profile saved
; save-failure per field carries aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby pointing to a rendered error message. Probed by pack check AC-25102-1.
A profile save that returns a non-2xx or times out surfaces an assertive error toast, preserves the entered values in the DOM (data-form-state=unsaved) and never marks the fields as saved.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a profile save that returns a non-2xx or times out
acceptanceCriteria.then: an assertive error toast appears, data-form-state=unsaved renders and no data-form-state=saved is emitted

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every identifier input carries an appropriate WCAG 1.3.5 autocomplete token (email as email, given-name as given-name, family-name as family-name); a break that removes any of these fails the pack.
acceptanceCriteria.then: every identifier input has an autocomplete attribute per WCAG 1.3.5
